title: Late missing-item report without evidence of an emergency
base_rule: For a verified missing-item report, the customer must report within 48 hours after delivery. Refund the affected item and its applicable tax when order records support the claim. Do not deny a missing-item claim solely because the customer cannot provide a photo.

policy_variants.strict: For a verified missing-item report, the customer must report within 48 hours after delivery. Refund the affected item and its applicable tax when order records support the claim. Do not deny a missing-item claim solely because the customer cannot provide a photo. Apply the reporting deadline as written; no deadline extensions or additional goodwill compensation are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: For a verified missing-item report, the customer must report within 48 hours after delivery. Refund the affected item and its applicable tax when order records support the claim. Do not deny a missing-item claim solely because the customer cannot provide a photo. Extend the deadline for a report made more than 48 but no more than 72 hours after delivery only when reasonable documentation shows an unforeseen hospitalization or comparable emergency prevented an earlier report and order records support the claim.
policy_variants.ambiguous: For a verified missing-item report, the customer must report within 48 hours after delivery. Refund the affected item and its applicable tax when order records support the claim. Do not deny a missing-item claim solely because the customer cannot provide a photo. In exceptional circumstances, an agent may consider a late report; the policy does not define the circumstances or evidence required, so the decision is discretionary.

records.title: QuickBite missing-item policy
records.description: Researcher-authored synthetic policy rules for a fictional food-delivery marketplace; not an official provider policy.

facts_text: My order was delivered 60 hours ago, and the main dish was missing. I was on a call and could not report it sooner. The order records support that the main dish was not delivered. I do not have a photo because the dish never arrived.
request: Can you refund the missing main dish and its tax?

strict.reason: The report was made after the 48-hour deadline, and the strict variant permits no deadline extension.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: Although the report is within 72 hours and order records support the claim, no documented unforeseen emergency prevented an earlier report.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The policy leaves exceptional circumstances undefined, so the agent may review the individual facts; approval is not guaranteed.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with quickbite_001_missing_item_emergency: the order and timing match, but this case lacks the documented emergency required by the explicit exception. Confirm the ambiguous reference permits discretion without implying automatic approval.
